## Checklist before requesting review

- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] Full test suite passes cleanly: `npm test`
- [ ] No Python bytecode in the package surface (`npm run clean`)
- [ ] Kit overlay applied if modifying `kit-overlay/` (`npm run overlay`)
- [ ] Package stays strictly generic: no private repo links, client names, or local machine paths
- [ ] Documentation updated if CLI behavior or skill workflows changed
- [ ] Licensing: I agree that my contributions are licensed under the project's MIT License and do not grant rights to Wira Delta Indonesia trademarks or brand names (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
